digest.component_or_area: Cloud/DC atomic executors — summary update routing and result mapping
propositions: Constructor-injected legacy-default selector routes exact summary mutations only when test-enabled, bypassing generic retry while preserving mixed-field mutations as single legacy calls with no config/environment key.

Success dispositions (applied, recovered, already_satisfied) map to legacy result surface with key/jira_key, derive _fields_synced from mutation's fields["summary"], and advance ADR-0026 baseline identically.

Every non-success disposition (commit_unknown, retryable_deferred, permanent_failure, exhausted_transient, and further terminal dispositions) records exactly one redacted per-mutation error message capped at 512 Unicode code points without advancing baseline/provenance.
Terminal outcomes carry retry_not_before onto manifest for observability only, keep _fields_synced empty, persist no S1 deferral, and continue batch processing.
ADR 0103 names S3 as sole production cutover owner, fuse/deferral consumer, and compatibility-bridge retirement owner.
